# Audit logs

`client.auditLogs.list({ page, limit }) → PaginatedResult<AuditLogEntry>` — project lifecycle (member added, credential rotated). Not CRUD, not per-resource. Empty for `ProjectRuntime` context.

Related: [Auth principal](/packages/sdk/v0.7.5/guides/auth)
